assumptions: Quarter defined as 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-31 (implemented as >= 2026-01-01 and < 2026-04-01).
Booked revenue interpreted as the sum of quantity * unit_price across order lines for qualifying orders.
Monetary values stored in integer cents are reported in whole USD by dividing by 100.
sql:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_cents),0) AS total_cents,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE o.customer_region = 'EMEA'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01';
